generated_by: Automated LabVIEW 2026 driving via ActiveX (LabVIEW.Application COM / VI Server)
method_that_worked: Method C/D (run existing VI via COM). Shipped, password-protected-but-runnable VIs in vi.lib/variable/tagger/mndui/config/gendialog/dataConversion.llb (NumToFlattenVariant.vi, BoolToFlattenVariant.vi, TextToFlattenVariant.vi) wire a typed front-panel control to LabVIEW's native Flatten-To-String and expose the raw result in the 'data string' indicator. Driven via GetVIReference + SetControlValue + Run + GetControlValue. Output read as BSTR and decoded with cp1252 (LabVIEW's ANSI->BSTR codepage); every captured value was byte-verified against its independently-computed expected value.
methods_A_B_result: IMPOSSIBLE. LabVIEW VI Scripting is not exposed through the ActiveX/VI-Server COM server (no Diagram/Node/Constant classes in the type library; NewVI/OpenVIReference/BlockDiagram and all node-creation names fail GetIDsOfNames on live Application and VI objects). Scripting is only available from inside G, which cannot be bootstrapped headlessly because no generator VI can be created without the GUI or an in-G scripting VI. g-cli is not installed; VI Server over TCP has the same object model (no scripting).
cross_checks: All captured cases verified: DBL 0.25->3fd0000000000000, DBL 1.0->3ff0000000000000, +Inf->7ff0000000000000, -Inf->fff0000000000000, NaN->7ff8000000000000, Bool TRUE->01, FALSE->00, String 'ABC'->00000003414243 (U32 big-endian length prefix confirms prepend-size default ON, big-endian confirmed). These match NI documentation exactly, confirming the bytes are genuine LabVIEW output.
